fusions.name: Heel Nip
fusions.desc: A quick weapon strike for 4 piercing damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rallying Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, you and your party deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Leash
fusions.desc: Calls a hound to your side for 15 seconds; it bites enemies within 2 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Held for the Thrust
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
